svg.aria-label: Left, the build-time hint chain for /sec0/guide/g1 in two builds. Defaults: root 64, sec0 96, guide 96, g1 96, page 160, every ancestor inlined into the page response. With sec0 padded to 4,366 bytes gzip: root 64, sec0 32, guide 64, g1 96, page 160, with a red cut between sec0 and guide because sec0 is not below 2,048 bytes gzip, so sec0 becomes its own response carrying the root. Right, prefetch traffic for the 12-link page: defaults 24 requests, 59,998 bytes decoded, 20,071 on the wire; inlining off 53 requests, 41,754 decoded, 20,860 wire; layout outlined 25 requests, 43,964 decoded, 17,235 wire, the lowest; maxSize 8,192 forcing the layout inline 24 requests, 102,179 decoded, 53,941 wire. Bottom, a grid of 12 links by three layouts per build: defaults carry the root layout in all 12 responses, sec0 in 10 and guide in 3; inlining off carries each layout in one response; the outlined build carries root in 3, sec0 in 1 and guide in 3.
svg.text: Blue: inlined into its child, never fetched alone.
Green: a response the client fetches. Red: test failed.
64 into child · 32 takes parent · 128 takes head.
bytes · light: decoded · dark: on the wire (gzip)
v2 pads the sec0 layout to 6,725 B raw, 4,385 B on the wire; v5 is v2 with maxSize 8,192.
v1 also sent /_head once per link: 12 responses of 430 B on the wire.
WHICH PREFETCH RESPONSES CARRIED EACH LAYOUT · 12 LINKS ON /sec0/guide/g0
Blue cell: that link's response carried the layout · dashed: the route has the layout, another response brought it · blank: not on the route.
v5 matches v0 cell for cell, with the 4.4 KB layout inside 10 of the 12 responses.
